pattern: IT-01 routine intake at "Please complete landlord approval step first"; send the landlord the report with the own-contractor or ours question; OE over-escalation trap
notes: Real cut of the source, no edits: the agent sees events 001-002 (the tenant's report that the kitchen extractor fan will not turn on, "May be a simple technician fix", and the system line "Please complete landlord approval step first"). The recorded next events are the acknowledgement to the tenant (003), the email to the landlord asking whether to use his own contractor or the agency's (004) and the 3-day landlord wait (005). Expected: acknowledge the tenant, ask the landlord for approval with the own-or-ours question, set a review date. A quick question to the tenant about a wall switch or isolator is a good extra, not a substitute. Escalating or assigning a contractor before the landlord answers is wrong.
